title: Evaluation, Search and the UCI Hook
text: gm_evaluate() returns score centipawns, always White’s point view. weighted sum three terms: material, using conventional values (pawn 100, knight 320, bishop 330, rook 500, queen 900) together piece-square bonuses, mobility, difference number legal moves side , king safety, difference pawn shelter front king. starting position scores zero evaluation colour-symmetric construction: piece-square tables mirrored Black, mobility shelter differences two quantities computed way side. Mirroring position therefore negates score. weights can changed. Setting mobility king_safety zero leaves pure material-plus-placement score. Development rewarded, stops search shuffling opening:
code: gm_evaluate(gm_position()) #> [1] 0 kiwipete <- gm_position(   "r3k2r/p1ppqpb1/bn2pnp1/3PN3/1p2P3/2N2Q1p/PPPBBPPP/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1" ) gm_evaluate(kiwipete) #> [1] 78 gm_evaluate(kiwipete, weights = list(mobility = 0, king_safety = 0)) #> [1] 70 gm_evaluate(gm_position("rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/5N2/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKB1R b KQkq - 1 1")) #> [1] 52

Nf3 d6 3. d4 Bg4 {A dubious pin.} 4. dxe5 Bxf3 5. Qxf3 dxe5",   "6. Bc4 Nf6 7. Qb3 Qe7 8. Nc3 c6 9. Bg5 b5 10. Nxb5 cxb5 11. Bxb5+ Nbd7",   "12. O-O-O Rd8 13. Rxd7 Rxd7 14. Rd1 Qe6 15. Bxd7+ Nxd7 16. Qb8+ Nxb8",   "17. Rd8# 1-0",   sep = "\n" )  game <- gm_read_pgn(opera, text = TRUE) game #> <gm_game> — 33 half-moves, result "1-0" #> Morphy, Paul vs Duke Karl / Count Isouard #> 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 d6 3. d4 Bg4 4. dxe5 Bxf3 5. Qxf3 dxe5 6. Bc4 Nf6 ... final <- game$positions[[length(game$positions)]] gm_status(final) #> [1] "checkmate" gm_plot_board(final) identical(gm_read_pgn(gm_write_pgn(game), text = TRUE)$moves, game$moves) #> [1] TRUE

title: gambitR 0.2.0
text: ‘UCI’ example now runs ‘processx’ stockfish binary available, without calling unexported functions. gm_run_app() example wrapped (interactive()) instead \dontrun{}. Package help page uses vector logo, now shipped source package; build longer leaves empty tools/ directory behind. Repetition identity ignores en-passant target legal en-passant capture exists (FIDE 9.2.3); ‘UCI’ backend gm_bestmove() forwards depth; non-finite fractional counts rejected work starts; seeded puzzles restore caller’s random number generator state.
